name: MAPPA EXPO, then the Kaoruhana signing
why: MAPPA EXPO takes the morning and the signing has a fixed 16:00 entry. Lunch and a few shops fill the gap, and the whole route is by train with no long walks.
steps: In front of the station. Coffee, then we go.
JR Sobu Rapid line to Tokyo Station
About 10 minutes. Then a 10 minute walk to Tokyo International Forum.
YURAKUCHO MUSEUM, B1F. About two hours.
Plenty of places under the tracks and in the station buildings. We pick one on the day.
Direct from Yurakucho Station, about 20 minutes.
Animate and the shops around it
Browse before the signing. Anime shops are all within a few minutes of the main store.
Entry is at 16:00. Please be early.
Kaoruhana exhibition and Mikami Saka signing
Last entry 16:30. The exhibition closes at 17:00 on this last day.
Dinner in Ikebukuro if you like, or JR back to Kinshicho.
moves: Kinshicho → Tokyo: JR Sobu Rapid, about 10 min. Tokyo → Forum: 10 min on foot. Yurakucho → Ikebukuro: Yurakucho line, about 20 min, no change.
good: Two fixed times, one in the morning and one at 16:00, with a flexible middle.
mind: Timings are estimates. Both venues are crowded on a Monday of a limited run, so we leave early rather than late.
